environment.clock: perf_counter_ns wall clock; serial operations; no deliberate warmup

combo: ABB10 teaching Hybrid + Luo module + BYTEAUTH; NOT CHKP
rng: deterministic test streams, disjoint per repetition and role; not production randomness

boundaries.setup: protocol.setup: actual HIBE and IBS Setup; excludes runtime creation and wire encoding
boundaries.extract_cold: protocol.skgen for Alice in each fresh master state
boundaries.extract_cached: protocol.skgen for the already-issued Alice; no new issuance
boundaries.sign: IBS Sign on raw 256-byte message, includes internal self-verification; excludes wire encoding
boundaries.encode: signature.to_bytes only; same mathematical signature in both formats
boundaries.decode: backend.load_signature only, includes validation; verify excluded
boundaries.verify: IBS Verify on already-decoded signature; decode excluded

unit: one fresh system and one authentic mathematical signature per repetition; formats share that signature
scope: five independent systems at default repeats; codec pairs alternate order; no end-to-end speed claim
